body.statement: Determine, from the primitive Hölder-margin geometry, an explicit piecewise function of \((T,\rho,\beta,\alpha,d,\delta)\) and prove that both \(W_{T,\delta}(\rho;\mathcal P_{\beta,\alpha}^{\mathrm{HM}})\) and \(\Omega_{T,\delta}(\rho;\mathcal P_{\beta,\alpha}^{\mathrm{HM}})\) are equivalent to it up to constants throughout \(\rho_{\mathrm{feas}}(T;\mathcal P_{\beta,\alpha}^{\mathrm{HM}})\le\rho\le T\). The derivation must locate every branch, budget-feasibility boundary, and flattening threshold, recover \(\rho^{-1/2}\) on \(\mathcal P_{\Delta_0,b_0}^{\mathrm{fg}}\), recover the fixed-design offline honest-width order when \(\rho\asymp T\), and resolve the \(d=1\), \(\beta=1\), \(\alpha=1/5\), \(\rho\asymp T^{3/5}\) Gaussian early-kill case.
body.justification: This is the theorem-level kernel: the rate and every transition are outputs rather than assumptions, so incorrect presolve exponents can be falsified.
body.gap: No located paper combines an all-design honest-length converse, nonsmooth scalar optimal-value geometry, and a welfare-budget-saturating contextual allocation. SimchiLeviWang2023BanditExperimentalDesign and LiShiSimchiLevi2024PrivateAdaptiveDesign use estimation error in finite-arm or finite-feature models; PraharajKhamaru2025AvoidingPriceAdaptivity combines linear-functional asymptotic Wald inference with near-minimax regret but has neither uniform nonregular honesty nor a hard welfare budget; LuedtkeVanDerLaan2016OptimalValue and PonomarevSemenova2024LowerConfidenceBand do not optimize adaptive welfare-constrained data collection.
body.consumer: The completed frontier tells experimenters the shortest credible post-trial statement about personalization gain compatible with a stated loss of participant welfare.

obligation.what_is_open: Derive the Hölder-local honest-width branch and exhibit one welfare-budgeted adaptive design and connected interval attaining it uniformly over the full model class.
obligation.obstruction: The only frozen proposed attaining construction is not an estimator or design map, and the bump lemma proved here changes a high-gap inferior regression but does not populate the sign-reversing alternative sets used by the allocation program. Consequently neither a local modulus exponent nor its upper match follows from the current primitives. Claiming equivalence would assume the named bottleneck.
obligation.attempted: Established the exact feasibility exponent, the all-procedure coverage-to-information reduction, the corrected fixed-gap \(\rho^{-1/2}\) frontier, and an adaptive-KL bump family. Also checked the early-kill specialization and bounded the target diameter.
obligation.partial_result:
The proved pieces give the following rigorous bracket in every feasible regime.  The targeting gain satisfies \(0\leq\theta(P)\leq2M\), because it is the pointwise gain of the better arm over a convex combination of the two arm means.  Thus, whenever \(\mathfrak D_T(\rho;\mathcal P_{\beta,\alpha}^{\mathrm{HM}})\) is nonempty, the constant interval \([0,2M]\) is honest and
\[
W_{T,\delta}(\rho;\mathcal P_{\beta,\alpha}^{\mathrm{HM}})\leq2M,
\qquad
\Omega_{T,\delta}(\rho;\mathcal P_{\beta,\alpha}^{\mathrm{HM}})\leq2M.
\]
Under the interior fixed-gap compatibility displayed in the proposed fixed-gap theorem, its two Gaussian witnesses also belong to the full H\"older--margin class.  For every design feasible over the full class, their welfare calculation and Gaussian divergence therefore give
\[
\Omega_{T,\delta}(\rho;\mathcal P_{\beta,\alpha}^{\mathrm{HM}})
\geq c\rho^{-1/2},
\qquad
W_{T,\delta}(\rho;\mathcal P_{\beta,\alpha}^{\mathrm{HM}})
\geq c'\rho^{-1/2}.
\]
Together with the feasibility result, this certifies
\[
c'\rho^{-1/2}\leq W_{T,\delta}(\rho;\mathcal P_{\beta,\alpha}^{\mathrm{HM}})\leq2M
\]
for \(\rho\geq\rho_{\mathrm{feas}}\), and value \(+\infty\) below feasibility.  In the early-kill case \(d=1\), \(\beta=1\), \(\alpha=1/5\), and feasible \(\rho\asymp T^{3/5}\), the compulsory lower branch is \(T^{-3/10}\).  What remains unproved is the gap-sensitive local lower rate and, more importantly, one explicit budget-feasible adaptive design and connected honest interval attaining the maximum of that local rate and the compulsory \(\rho^{-1/2}\) term.
